source: No spin axis of VHS 1256-1257 b on the sky is measured (Zhou et al. 2020 measure a rotation period of about 22 hours, and Poon et al. 2024 find the spin axis near the plane of the sky, but not its direction). The display axis is the normal of its hosted orbit in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/vhs-1256-1257-b.json, computed by hostedKeplerElements in @cssearth/astronomy; the meridian is set so that grid longitude 0 faces the Sun and Earth at the scene epoch.
coordinateSystem: ICRF/J2000. +Z is the display axis, the orbit normal; +X is the display meridian; east longitude. No spin is propagated.
qualification: Display convention, not a measurement: the spin axis, spin sense, period and prime meridian of VHS 1256-1257 b are unmeasured; the axis shown is its orbit normal.
